products.title: Fall Bundle: Blue Angels + Monarch Butterflies
products.description_html:
Both remaining fall day trips in one purchase, with a guaranteed spot on each and $20 off the drop-in rate.

Sunday, Oct. 11 and Friday, Nov. 27

Your whole fall, planned for you and your family — with our signature outings! 🍂✈️🦋

We have so much FUN on these adventures — they sell out every year — so this fall we're capping numbers and prioritizing families who choose the bundle option first. One purchase here secures your family's spot at both outings below — no need to visit each outing's individual page or buy anything else. Bundle families get priority booking and guaranteed spots, and your family saves $20 compared to booking each one separately at the drop-in rate.

✈️ 10/11 — Blue Angels Front-Row View, Tunnels, Cannons, Beach Play & Optional DoorDash Dinner (San Francisco)
🦋 11/27 — Black Friday: Monarch Butterflies, Tidepools, Beach & Optional Pizza + Ice Cream (Santa Cruz Area)

✅ WHAT HAPPENS AFTER YOU BUY:

This is your only checkout — you're done! You do not need to purchase anything on the individual outing pages. Closer to each date, you'll get:

  • digital guide — one for each of the 2 outings, sent separately as that date approaches.

  • a separate WhatsApp invite for each adventure

  • any adventure-specific details (like DoorDash headcount for Blue Angels or pizza sign-up for Black Friday)

WHAT'S INCLUDED IN EACH ADVENTURE

A quick taste of what's ahead — full details for each adventure are on individual listing pages, linked below.

✈️ 10/11 Blue Angels (San Francisco): A secret-gem vantage point near the Golden Gate Bridge, old military tunnels and cannons to explore, a scavenger hunt, and beach play with a chance to spot harbor seals.

View full listing: Blue Angels Front-Row View, Tunnels & Beach

🦋 11/27 Black Friday (Santa Cruz Area): An easy hike to see migrating monarch butterflies (kid-friendly telescope included!), tidepooling, a small cave, and stunning sunset views.

View full listing: Black Friday Monarchs, Tidepools & Beach

products.title: Winter Bundle: Chestnuts, Waterfalls + Redwoods
products.description_html:
All three winter day trips in one purchase, with a guaranteed spot at each: chestnuts in October, waterfalls in December and redwoods on MLK Day.

Oct. 25, Dec. 13 and Jan. 18

Your whole winter season, planned for you and your family — with our signature outings! 🌰💦🐌

We have so much FUN on these adventures — they sell out every year — so this season we're capping numbers and prioritizing families who choose the bundle option first. One purchase here secures your family's spot at all 3 outings below — no need to visit each outing's individual page or buy anything else. Bundle families get priority booking and guaranteed spots, and your family saves $30 compared to booking each one separately at today's rates.

🌰 10/25 — Chestnut Collecting, Chestnut Honey Tasting, Golden Fall Leaves, Lake Hike + Optional Pizza Dinner (La Honda Area)
💦 12/13 — Winter Waterfall Wonderland, Ladybug Love, Leopard-Spotted Banana Slugs + Fungi Hunt (South Bay)
🐌 1/18 — MLK Day: Banana Slug Bonanza, 1,700-Year-Old Redwood + Ancient Ocean Rocks (Peninsula)

✅ WHAT HAPPENS AFTER YOU BUY:

This is your only checkout — you're done! You do not need to purchase anything on the individual outing pages. Closer to each date, you'll get:

  • digital guide — one for each of the 3 outings, sent separately as that date approaches.

  • a separate WhatsApp invite for each adventure

  • any adventure-specific details (like the Alice's Restaurant headcount for food after chestnut collecting as well as for MLK Day)

WHAT'S INCLUDED IN EACH ADVENTURE

A quick taste of what's ahead — full details for each adventure are on individual listing pages, linked below.

🌰 10/25 Chestnut Collecting (La Honda Area): A 100+-year-old chestnut orchard with golden fall leaves to run through, chestnut honey tasting, an easy lake hike with ducks, geese and a century-old oak to climb, a scavenger hunt, and an optional early dinner at Alice's Restaurant.

View full listing: Chestnut Orchard, Honey Tasting & a Lake Hike

💦 12/13 Winter Waterfall (South Bay): Rushing waterfalls, a funghi hunt, leopard-spotted banana slugs, rock scrambling, a scavenger hunt, and a visit to our Ladybug Christmas Tree (ladybug sightings depend on their migration, but we've seen lots here in past years).

View full listing: Winter Waterfalls, Ladybugs & Banana Slugs

🐌 1/18 MLK Day (Peninsula): A 1,700-year-old redwood giant, banana slugs by the dozens (we found 50+ in previous years!), ancient ocean rocks to explore, a nature scavenger hunt, and an optional meal at the legendary Alice's Restaurant.

View full listing: MLK Day Redwoods, Banana Slugs & Ocean Rocks💦
